parsed.what_i_tried: Reviewed MB-T06 Description, Red, and Green sections. MB-T06 Green acceptance requires end-to-end operator-clicked card delivery with merged free-form payload landing in the session per §7.4 Item A. MB-T06 Red acceptance requires all 3 assertions of test_send_routes_to_daemon.spec.ts to pass. With 1 test failing, the session is not at a green-commit-ready state. Operator directive 'send a follow-up' is ambiguous between two materially different actions: (a) a diagnostic/investigative send to resolve the failure, or (b) a continuation send that treats the partial pass as sufficient. These are not equivalent routing decisions. MB-T06 has no Open Questions section and no Multi-choice Template covers this ambiguity.
parsed.where_im_stuck: Rule 2 prohibits inference as a resolution path. The two interpretations produce divergent outcomes: interpretation (a) keeps the session in the Red phase and routes to failure investigation; interpretation (b) advances the session toward Green despite a failing test, which may violate MB-T06 acceptance criteria. No build-doc section adjudicates which operator intent is correct. MC-test-failure-route covers ambiguity between tickets, not ambiguity about intent within a single ticket. MC-prompt-tone covers tone selection, not goal selection. No pre-anticipated multi-choice template applies. Escape is required.
